fact: Biometric Update reports, citing the IMIJ presentation at ID4Africa 2026, that Cabo Verde reached 99 percent birth registration, up from about 91 percent before the reforms.
IMIJ's ID4Africa 2026 deck gives birth registration in Cabo Verde as about 99-100% (presenter's approximation).

INE's vital statistics report for 2023 says the registry directorate's (RNI) registration services have been computerised with NOSi since 2004, and builds its count of 6,760 births registered in 2023 from the RNI's registration database.
INE's report says deaths, like births and marriages, are drawn from the RNI's computerised registration database and checked against the health ministry's information system.
The World Bank's World Development Indicators list completeness of birth registration in Cabo Verde at 91.4% for 2010, a national rate not tied to a digital system.

The World Bank's SPI lists Cabo Verde as meeting SDG 17.19.2, birth registration at least 90% and death registration at least 75% complete, in its 2024 round; no digital system is tied to it and the year is the survey round's.
